facts.fact: StackAdapt launched StackAdapt Brand Lift as a self-serve feature available to all users, announced in a press release dated September 10, 2024.
facts.quote: today launched StackAdapt Brand Lift as a self-serve feature available to all users.

facts.fact: According to StackAdapt, users can initiate a Brand Lift study within minutes.
facts.quote: With the ability to initiate a Brand Lift study within minutes, users can now gain immediate, actionable insights

facts.fact: According to StackAdapt, its self-serve Brand Lift studies are offered at no extra charge.
facts.quote: access real-time reporting directly within the platform—all at no extra charge.

facts.fact: According to StackAdapt, its Brand Lift solution supports native, display, video, CTV, OTT, audio (regular and streaming), and in-game advertising channels.
facts.value: native, display, video, CTV, OTT, audio (regular and streaming), in-game
facts.quote: across native, display, video, CTV, OTT, audio (regular and streaming), and in-game advertising

facts.fact: StackAdapt describes its Brand Lift workflow as 100% self-serve, letting marketers start and stop studies at their convenience.
facts.quote: offering a seamless, one-stop-shop experience with a 100% self-serve workflow.

facts.fact: StackAdapt is rated the number 1 demand-side platform (DSP) on G2, according to the company.
facts.quote: is rated [the number 1 demand-side platform](https://www.stackadapt.com/best-demand-side-platform-dsp) (DSP) on G2

facts.fact: StackAdapt is used by hundreds of brands and agencies around the world, according to its own description.
facts.quote: StackAdapt is a multi-channel programmatic advertising platform used by hundreds of brands and agencies around the world.
